name: pricing-plans-section
purpose: The plan cards at the top of Pricing: a billing-period toggle over a framed row of pricing cards, each with its plan name, its price for the picked period, what it includes and one button. The recommended plan sits on a raised surface and carries a tag. It is a page section — the site places it from a `{ _id: 'pricing-plans-section', props }` entry and binds `props` straight onto it — and it composes `registration-frame`, `toggle-group`, `card-grid`, `pricing-card` and `button`; the picked period is local state. The band runs full bleed (the page's inline inset only, closed by a bottom rule) and centres its frame at the site measure, with rules on its sides.
useWhen: Use PricingPlansSection for price cards with a billing-period toggle on the public pricing page, the plans side by side at the top of Pricing.
avoidWhen: To compare plans or support tiers feature by feature → use `plan-comparison-section`.
To compare Azion with one competitor → use `competitor-comparison-section`.
related: `pricing-card` — the card each plan renders with.
`plan-comparison-section` — the matrix that sits under these cards.
bestPractices: Give every plan one price per period, matched by `period`; a price without a `period` applies to every period.
Highlight one plan; it is raised and is the only card that shows its tag.
Put terms that hold for every period in the plan's `description`; a price's own `details` replaces it for that period.
Keep `features` to five or so short labels led by an icon.

props.name: anchor
props.doc: In-page id set on the band so a hash link can target it.

props.name: periods
props.doc: The billing periods of the toggle, in order; each is `{ label, value }`. The toggle shows with two or more and opens on the first.

props.name: periodsAriaLabel
props.doc: Accessible name of the billing-period toggle.

props.name: plans
props.doc: The plan cards, in order; each is `{ name, description?, highlighted?, tagLabel?, prices, featuresTitle?, features?, action? }` where a price is `{ period?, value, prefix?, suffix?, details? }`, a feature is `{ icon, label }` and `action` is `{ label, href }`; `description` stands in for a price without `details`, a plan without a name is dropped, and an action without a label or href is dropped.
